newsitem.title: USA: Weirton begins $83 million furnace rebuild.
newsitem.headline: Weirton begins $83 million furnace rebuild.

text.p: Weirton Steel Corp said Friday it has started an $83 million project to rebuild its No. 1 blast furnace.
The company expects the rebuilt furnace, whose daily production of molten metal will rise 400 tons a day to 4,000 tonnes a day, to be completed by the spring of 1997.

It said it will revive its idled 2,800 ton-a-day No. 4 furnace and run it in tandem with its No. 3 furnace, plus make spot makret purchases to make up the output shortfall while the project is ongoing.
